title: What faces in paintings can tell us about how we perceive emotion
summary: Look closely at a face in a painting and you might think you know what emotion the person is experiencing. A smile suggests happiness. A furrowed brow might signal anger. Widened eyes could mean fear or surprise. But what happens when you ask lots of people the same question? Do they see the same emotion, or something more complicated?
imageAlt: What faces in paintings can tell us about how we perceive emotion

title: Serengeti hyenas manage to keep clans stable as climate change alters animal migrations
summary: Although the main prey of spotted hyenas (Crocuta crocuta), migratory ungulates such as blue wildebeest (Connochaetes taurinus), now spend substantially less time within hyena territories than they did 30 years ago, hyena clans in the central Serengeti have remained largely stable.

title: Proglašena najbolja prva klasa na svijetu: Putnici dobivaju iskustvo kakvo se rijetko viđa u zrakoplovima
summary: Dok se većina putnika u zrakoplovima bori za malo prostora za noge i sanjari o što bržem slijetanju, u najekskluzivnijem dijelu neba putovanje je postalo sinonim za čisti hedonizam. title: Mladi Hrvati masovno štede i ulažu, ali šefica HUB-a upozorava na opasnu zamku
summary: Čak 87 posto mladih u Hrvatskoj štedi, a 44 posto samostalno ulaže novac, najčešće u kriptovalute. No istraživanje Hrvatske udruge banaka (HUB) i Sveučilišta Algebra Bernays pokazalo je i da se velik dio mladih o financijama informira putem društvenih mreža i umjetne inteligencije. Direktorica HUB-a Tamara Perko u Dnevniku HRT-a upozorila je na rizike takvih savjeta, istaknuvši da eventualne financijske gubitke neće snositi ni influenceri ni umjetna inteligencija, već oni koji su novac uložili

title: Ancient fish bones reveal how Arctic cod species survived the last ice age
summary: The glacial Arctic Ocean was not a barren ice desert but a breeding ground for the evolution of cold adaptation in marine fish. This is the main conclusion of a new scientific publication from Stockholm University that examines small fish bones found in deep-sea sediments during an expedition aboard the Swedish icebreaker Oden.
imageAlt: Ancient fish bones reveal how Arctic cod species survived the last ice age
